src/core/storage/disk/wal/: flush_group(upto: Lsn)  // flushes once for every commit waiting below this position

sketch: conflicts.check(txn)  # fails when another transaction wrote the same row first
at: Timestamp = next_timestamp()  # the commit time fixes the order other transactions see
lsn: Lsn = wal.append(records_of(txn, at))  # the changes are appended to the log
wal.flush_group(lsn)  # one flush serves every commit waiting in the group
replicas.ship(lsn)  # the other nodes receive the log

name: Prepared statement cache
line: a repeated statement skips parsing and planning

src/core/sql/: cached_plan(session: Session, sql: Text) → Plan?  // returns the plan kept from an earlier run of the same text, if any

sketch: plan: Plan | None = sql.cached_plan(session, message.sql)  # the same text run before keeps its plan, so most statements skip the next two steps
stmt: Statement = sql.compile(message.sql, catalog)  # text to a checked, bound statement
plan = optimizer.optimize(stmt, catalog)  # chooses how to run it
snapshot: Snapshot = transactions.snapshot(session.txn)  # the query sees the database as of now, whatever commits meanwhile
rows: RowStream = execution.run(plan, snapshot)  # the plan is cut into pipelines that run on worker threads
while batch := results.next(rows):  # rows go back in batches as they are ready
